Twenty-six barangays.

Ibaan is divided into 26 barangays. This page keeps the names, the interactive map, and the gaps in one place.

Barangay names and the official count come from the municipal profile. The outlines follow source geometry, but they are not legal boundaries.

Find a barangay.

Filter the index, switch between 2D and 3D, and reset the view. The tilted view shows real terrain and building height from public map data, not population or land area.

3D shows OpenStreetMap terrain and buildings. Height is not a data value.

Boundary note

Source

OCHA COD-AB administrative boundaries from NAMRIA and PSA, released 2023-11-06 and redistributed with PSGC codes by faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles. Upstream data is CC BY-IGO 3.0; the redistribution wrapper is MIT.

Precision

These outlines keep their source vertex detail, so they follow the mapped barangay shapes rather than coarse tiles. They are still orientation aids, not survey, jurisdiction, or legal boundary records.

Map services

The interactive map loads OpenStreetMap data through OpenFreeMap and requests terrain tiles for the 3D view. A plain SVG outline is available when WebGL is unavailable.
